snippet.title: The Aurora Chronicles | Episode 3: The Wreck | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Episode 3: The Wreck launches August 17 on Steam and iOS.

Long-range telemetry has flagged something crossing the outer frontier.
Interstellar, unclassified, three kilometers along its longest axis. The
third ever confirmed in Alliance space. The first two were watched and
lost.

Something inside it repeats every eleven seconds.

Thirty-six hours before the trajectory carries it beyond Aurora's reach.
The crew goes aboard to find out what happened.

The Aurora Chronicles is available now in Early Access on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262410/The_Aurora_Chronicles/

The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel following a
four-person crew investigating frontier mysteries aboard the FRV Aurora.
Your choices shape relationships, leadership style, and what the crew
uncovers.

Full English voice acting. Original soundtrack. Playable in English,
French, and Japanese.

Follow development:
X: https://x.com/entropy_42_
Soundtrack: https://aurorachronicles.bandcamp.com/

#visualnovel #indiegame #scifi #indiedev
